ifDeleted.summary: Nine Tickets is the hinge between the layoffs and the hack: SJ hands Brendan the Mac Studio, Brendan leaves still asking why he was fired, and the audience learns the real reason (Kristina's copy tool only moved the test ticket, so Brendan closed nine tickets on the sheet). Deleting it saves the whole Marcus Luddite call and the resume advice, but the computer handoff and the nine-tickets payoff must be carried into s20, and several later lines lose their source.
